risks.risk: Screen/panel damage may exist even if the seller says only the transformer is blown.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the screen in a lit room (with the screen off) plus a photo/video with the TV powered on showing the display/backlight.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially having panel issues (worst case).

risks.risk: Exact model/series is unknown, which affects parts availability and repair cost.
risks.proof: Photo of the TV back label/serial/model number (sticker) and the power rating label.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the worst-case generic repair scenario for an unknown LG TV.

risks.proof: Photos of included items: remote, stand/base, and power cable; show ports clearly.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the TV back label showing LG brand + model/serial number.
Send a short video: plug in, power on, show whether there is backlight/boot/logo or it stays black.
If possible, show the power supply/board area or any opened photo indicating the transformer damage (close-up).
Confirm what is included: remote, stand/base, and power cable (photos).
response.reason: From the single photo, the TV brand/model/size and the stated transformer fault cannot be verified, and the screen/power status is not testable visually. To price safely, we need proof of power-on behavior and the model label.
